name: 维修（更换/保养/测试）服务

map.设备保养计划与更换清单: Equipment upkeep plan and replacement list
map.本工具用于维修（更换/保养/测试）服务的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实: This tool validates the legality of maintenance (replace/upkeep/test) service, checking against the corresponding data format and syntax specification in real time and locating errors; runs purely front-end, no data upload.
map.保养排程：按设备类型与保养等级生成保养项目清单: Upkeep scheduling: generate the upkeep item list by equipment type and upkeep level.
map.备件准备：按保养等级输出需更换部件清单，提前备货: Spare prep: output the parts-to-replace list by upkeep level for advance stocking.
map.大修决策：按累计运行小时判断是否应安排大修: Overhaul decision: judge from cumulative operating hours whether an overhaul is due.
map.算法：设备类型（1 泵类、2 电机、3 阀门管道、4 减速机、5 换热器）叠加保: Algorithm: equipment type (1 pumps, 2 motors, 3 valves/piping, 4 reducers, 5 heat exchangers) combined with upkeep level (1 daily, 2 monthly, 3 annual, 4 overhaul) generates the corresponding items; level 1 has 5 items (inspection, cleaning, lubrication, fastening, logging), level 2 has 5 (seals, oil change, bearings, electrical, instrument calibration), level 3 has 6 (disassembly inspection, wear parts, alignment, electrical test, anti-corrosion, 2-hour full-load test), overhaul has 6 (full disassembly, main-part replacement, datum-surface repair, reassembly, full test, paint/anti-corrosion); the replacement-parts list grows with level (level 1 only greases, overhaul includes bearings/seals/impeller or rotor/electrical parts/fasteners); cumulative >20000 h suggests overhaul, >10000 h suggests more frequent level-3 upkeep.
map.例：泵类设备 + 一级保养 + 使用 3 年 + 累计 8000h → 输出 5: Example: pump + level 1 + 3 years use + 8000 h -> 5 daily upkeep items, replacement only lubricating grease (top-up), hours in normal range, no extra hint. If changed to level 3 + 15000 h -> 6 annual items, 4 replacement categories (full bearing set, full seal set, full oil, electrical parts), hint: cumulative over 10000 h, increase level-3 frequency. If 25000 h -> triggers: over 20000 h, schedule overhaul. Acceptance baseline: vibration <=2.8 mm/s, temperature <= allowed, no leak, performance met.
map.振动 ≤2.8mm/s 是哪来的？: Where does vibration <=2.8 mm/s come from?
map.2.8mm/s（有效值）是 ISO 10816/20816 中中小型机组常用的「: 2.8 mm/s (RMS) is the upper limit of the good/satisfactory zone for small/medium machines in ISO 10816/20816, a common criterion for general mechanical vibration. Specific equipment should pick its alarm and trip thresholds per its vibration-severity class (e.g. ISO 10816-3 by power and rigid/flexible support); do not generalize.
map.累计小时和日历年限哪个更重要？: Which matters more, cumulative hours or calendar years?
map.对连续运转设备，累计运行小时更能反映磨损程度，应作为主判据；日历年限主要用于评估: For continuously running equipment, cumulative operating hours better reflect wear and should be the main criterion; calendar years mainly assess rubber aging, coating failure and oil degradation. For intermittently running equipment it is the reverse; when they conflict, take the stricter one for scheduling.
map.一级保养每日进行，二级保养月度执行，三级保养年度实施: Level 1 upkeep daily, level 2 monthly, level 3 annual.
map.累计运行超过20000小时建议大修保养: Cumulative over 20000 h suggests overhaul upkeep.
map.保养后需进行振动、温度、密封等测试验收: After upkeep, vibration, temperature and seal tests are required for acceptance.
map.维修（更换/保养/测试）服务工具，输入设备类型、保养等级、使用年限和累计运行小时: The maintenance (replace/upkeep/test) service tool, taking equipment type, upkeep level, service years and cumulative operating hours, generates the upkeep plan, parts-to-replace list and post-upkeep test standards for the corresponding level. Suitable for preventive maintenance of pumps, motors, valves/piping, reducers and heat exchangers.
map.根据运行小时提供保养建议: Gives upkeep advice by operating hours
